summary: Twin-spired cathedral at the head of Đồng Khởi: look from the square in the early morning for both towers. The church is at 1 Công trường Công xã Paris, opposite the post office, in unplastered brick from Marseille, consecrated in 1880. The statue in front is Carrara marble from Pietrasanta, and also alabaster.

body: The church is at 1 Công trường Công xã Paris, Phường Sài Gòn, at the head of Đồng Khởi. The older label is Ben Nghe, District 1. The English name is the Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception. Design is credited to architect Bourard and Bishop Colombert, consecrated in 1880, in unplastered brick ordered from Marseille. Construction is also dated from 1863 to 1880, with materials imported from France.

Đức Mẹ Hòa Bình in front is Carrara marble carved at Pietrasanta. An alabaster statue of the Virgin in the square is also said to have wept once in 2005. Come early for the look from the square. The post office is the building opposite. The photograph is the facade: both towers, the clock, and the rose window, with scaffolding along the right side. The spire tips sit above the frame. Ask at the gate about the interior.
